questions.question: Which aids are typically allowed during the written English exam?
options: A printed dictionary and your own preparatory notes
questions.explanation: You may normally use a printed dictionary and your own notes from the preparation day — not the internet or AI tools.

questions.question: What should you underline when reading an exam task?
options: Key requirements: text type, audience, topic, task word and length
questions.explanation: Underline the key requirements so you answer exactly what is asked — many students lose marks by answering the wrong question.

questions.question: What happens on the preparation day before the exam?
options: You receive the theme and preparatory materials
You get the grades from last year
questions.explanation: The day before the exam you receive the theme and preparatory materials, which you may bring notes from.

questions.question: Why is time spent planning during the exam "never wasted"?
options: Good planning produces better-structured answers and prevents time problems
Planning counts directly toward the grade
Plans replace the need to proofread
questions.explanation: Students who plan perform better: planning gives structure, keeps you on task and prevents running out of time.

questions.question: Which mistake do many students make on exam day?
options: Spending too long on one question and rushing the rest
questions.explanation: Common pitfalls include poor time management, misreading tasks, skipping proofreading and letting nerves take over.
